data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of its gross claims reserves for prior underwriting years, amounting to GBP 5.617 million, representing an 83.89% increase relative to its opening gross reserves. This adverse development was primarily driven by an increase in losses from Hurricane Ida and COVID-19 exposure, which also contributed to the overall loss for the financial year. The claims development table indicates strengthening across older underwriting years, particularly 2019 and 2018.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure was calculated from the gross claims development triangle as no explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision' note or narrative gross figure was available. The LOBs affected by Hurricane Ida and COVID-19 are inferred from the general description of the business and not explicitly stated for the reserve movements.
